devin (acct-mgr): Quick heads-up — Neptune Labs is pushing for a Dedicated reservation for the winter promo window. They want heavy burst capacity around Black Friday -> Cyber Monday. Asking: commit w/ burst allowance. Can we model the numbers?

ashley (infra): Do we have their target throughput? GPU types?

devin (acct-mgr): They quoted: ~1.8k GPU-hours/day peak (A100-ish), for a 6-week spike (late Nov -> early Jan). Outside spike they expect ~400 GPU-hours/day. They're open to commit + burst tokens.

ashley (infra): Quick back-of-envelope: 1.8k GPU-hrs/day => ~54k GPU-hrs/month. If we size for spike full-time you'd need ~75 x A100 equiv (24h). For baseline 400/hr => ~13 GPUs.

ashley (infra): If we offer commit = baseline (13 GPUs) + reserved burst pool (tokenized) for spikes, buffer policy matters. Typical buffer we require ~20% headroom for scheduler slack and failed nodes. That affects reserved count.

ashley (infra): Proposal A (simple): commit 15 GPUs reserved (baseline + 15% headroom) + 60k burst GPU-hours prepaid tokens for 6 weeks. Cost wise it's ~ commit_monthly + prepaid_burst_discount.

ashley (infra): Proposal B (higher commit): commit 50 GPUs with 10% buffer, includes limited seasonal ramp (up to 2x baseline) as part of SLA. This locks capacity but raises price.

yonatan (platform): If we do tokenized bursts we need router rules: route to Dedicated until tokens exhausted, then automatic fallback to Hosted API (lower cost) or lower-tier quantized model. Also need regional placement — Neptune requires EU region for latency/compliance. EU capacity is tight in late Nov.

tessa (sre): Operationally: big swings increase queue jitter. We should cap continuous burst concurrency per-customer (eg max 200 concurrent requests) and recommend batch size tuning. Also add a short warmup window to prepopulate KV caches before peak.

devin (acct-mgr): Legal asked if we can include a 2-week one-time carryover on unused burst tokens. They also want a carve-out if we hit infra-imposed throttles.

legal: We can do carryover clause but need explicit throttling SLA language. Any fallback (hosted) must have defined latency and throughput degradation curve in contract.

ashley (infra): Important cost points: EU H100 inventory is tight. If they insist on H100 equivalency we may need a price premium or a multi-region fallback. Also network egress for large dataset loads during onboarding — add a one-time data-transfer credit line.

ashley (infra): Sample calc (code block):
```
peak: 1800 GPU-hrs/day -> 54k GPU-hrs/month
baseline: 400 GPU-hrs/day -> 12k GPU-hrs/month
commit baseline (15 GPUs): 15 * 24 * 30 = 10.8k GPU-hrs/month
prepaid burst tokens needed for 6 weeks peak ~ (54k-10.8k)*1.5 months ~= 65k GPU-hrs (rough)
buffer: +20% -> reserve planning 13->16 GPUs equivalent
```

ashley (infra): That ~65k burst tokens is a lot; suggest selling it as "seasonal token pack" at ~40% discount vs on-demand, with a usage cap to protect other customers.

devin (acct-mgr): Neptune needs a number today for ACV calc. Can we give them two offers: conservative (lower commit + big token pack) and premium (higher commit, smaller tokens, stronger SLA)?

yonatan (platform): Yes. Conservative = commit 15 GPUs + 65k tokens + EU fallback -> cheaper. Premium = commit 50 GPUs + 10k tokens + stricter regional SLA + higher price.

tessa (sre): For either offer: require an operational playbook (runbook) + pre-scheduled ramp tests. Recommend a staged canary over 48hrs before full promotional traffic.

oncall-bot: Incident summary: EU region sustained 70% capacity utilization during last Black Friday window (2024-11-29). Predictive model indicates similar strain if multiple customers spike simultaneously.

oncall-bot: Suggested mitigation: limit simultaneous hard bursts to 2 customers per cluster and enable cross-region spillover.

devin (acct-mgr): Perfect — I'll draft proposals: "Conservative token pack" and "Premium reserved" and loop in legal + sales ops. Any final objections? :thumbsup:

yonatan (platform): No objections. Make sure the contract calls out fallback behavior and routing priorities.

tessa (sre): +1. Add mandatory pre-ramp test slot in contract (48hr).

legal: I'll prepare the SLA snippets and throttling language.

devin (acct-mgr): Thanks team — I'll drop the draft in #sales once ready and ping @ashley to sanity-check numbers before sending.
